snippet.title: Truxton Extreme - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
A New Truxton Approaches! 38 years after Yuge Masahiro's Truxton made its first mark on the gaming world, a whole new adventure awaits!
Prepare to face both new and returning bosses, as Junya Inoue's beautifully illustrated comics immerse you in the world like never before!

Truxton Extreme will be available for PC, Nintendo Switch, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on July 30th! Can you pilot your way to victory?

Wishlist now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3323490/Truxton_Extreme/
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014568/
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/truxton-extreme/9NMGVV98C2VW
https://www.gog.com/en/game/truxton_extreme
